league.description:
Sport and league as ESPN names them, e.g. "basketball/nba",
"football/nfl", "hockey/nhl", "baseball/mlb", "soccer/eng.1".

sample.description:
Read this file instead of calling ESPN: a saved scoreboard reply. For
tests and demos.

teams.description:
Only games with one of these teams: abbreviations ("BOS") or whole
words of the name ("Celtics", "Los Angeles"), ignoring case. Default:
every game.

entries.description: Today's games and scores for a league (NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, football leagues and more), live games first, optionally only your teams. Click a game to open it on ESPN. ESPN's public scoreboard API: no key, but undocumented.
entries.name: Scores
